query: Hitting the kerbs and walls feels weak. Add punchier feedback on collisions and gear shifts (screen shake, a short hit-stop, some particles) but it must not alter lap times or the physics-characterization results.
kerb strikes at monza feel like nothing happens, can you make them rumble more - a bit of shake and the pad buzz - without touching grip
When two cars touch there is no impact at all on screen. Add a hit-stop and sparks on car-to-car contact, and prove obs()/act() runs still replay identically.
Gear shifts sound and look flat. Layer a small camera tick and a stronger shift sound on upshifts at high rpm; keep it cosmetic.
Going off at Spa the gravel kickup barely shows and there are no tyre marks; make the off-track moment read better visually without changing the sim.
The car still understeers on turn-in after my kerb feedback change; run a step-steer A/B on frontGrip and tell me if the balance moved.
The chase camera lags behind the car in fast corners and the framing drifts. Take before/after screenshots at Eau Rouge and tune the camera smoothing.
My gamepad rumble is mapped to the wrong motor and the dead zone is too large; fix the controller vibration mapping and stick calibration.
